name: willow
description: Publish explicitly selected public Atomic properties as a Willow drop of host-signed, Meadowcap-authorised entries.

keys.name: willow
keys.reason: This installation's Willow subspace key. The host signs Willow entries with it, only in the configured communal namespace and under the configured path prefix.

http.reason: Serves the selected resources, as far as anyone may read them, as a Willow drop that other Willow peers can import.

capabilities.name: storage
capabilities.reason: Read approved Atomic resources and propose reviewed unsigned export records.

subjects.description: Explicit Atomic resource subjects to export

properties.description: Explicit property subjects included in each JSON-AD payload

outputParent.description: Unsigned candidate job only: Atomic parent for reviewed unsigned export candidates

namespace.description: Willow namespace id, 64 hex characters. The drop route needs a communal one (last byte even).

subspace.description: Unsigned candidate job only: Willow subspace id, 64 hex characters. The drop route uses the installation's own key.

pathPrefix.description: Willow binary path components as hexadecimal strings

timestamp.description: Unsigned candidate job only: explicit logical Willow U64 timestamp as decimal text; increase after source changes
